title: Hut 8 Corp. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-27
summary: Hut 8 Corp, a crypto mining and data center company listed on Nasdaq (ticker: HUT), disclosed via Form 8-K that its subsidiary Hut 8 DC LLC is planning a private offering of $3.248 billion in senior secured notes due 2042 to fund construction of a 245-megawatt data center at its River Bend campus in St. Francisville, Louisiana.
key_points: Hut 8 DC LLC announced intention to offer $3.248 billion aggregate principal in senior secured notes due 2042
Proceeds will finance a 245-megawatt data center project at the River Bend campus in St. Francisville, Louisiana
Notes are being offered in a private placement to qualified institutional buyers under Rule 144A and Regulation S
The offering is also intended to reimburse the Company for prior equity contributions and fund debt service reserves
This is a corporate-level financing announcement, not a regulatory or policy document
